ranges.description: Blood Lord is a young man with long hair that falls loose over his face and is often swept back. His eyes are blood-red with a faint red glow; the sclera turns blood-red when his power surges. His eyes curve like half-moons when he smiles and narrow to slits when he is intent, and his face can twist into a fierce, grim scowl. Tags: male, young man, long hair, swept-back hair, blood-red eyes, glowing red eyes, red sclera, crescent smiling eyes, narrowed eyes, fierce grim expression
